title: Usul al-Sarakhsi
author: as-sarakhsi
attributionNote: The attribution is the one the manuscript tradition and the scholarship give.
description: Al-Sarakhsi's account of Hanafi legal theory: how commands and prohibitions bind, how general and specific texts are read together, abrogation, the Prophet's acts, consensus, analogy and juristic preference. It sets out the method behind the rulings of his al-Mabsut.
historicalContext: Like al-Mabsut, much of the work is reported to have been dictated while al-Sarakhsi was imprisoned in Uzgend. It stands with al-Bazdawi's Usul as the classic statement of the Hanafi approach, which derives its theory from the school's established cases.
availabilityNote: Arabic text only, streamed from OpenITI at read time. No English translation is included because no public-domain English translation was verified. Only the catalogue record, chapter outline and passage index are held here.
